sentences.en: God created the heaven and the earth
alt: God created the heavens and the earth
sentences.pt: Deus criou o céu e a terra

sentences.en: The earth was without form and void
sentences.pt: A terra era sem forma e vazia

sentences.en: The earth was empty and dark
sentences.pt: A terra estava vazia e escura

sentences.en: Darkness was upon the face of the deep
sentences.pt: Havia trevas sobre a face do abismo

sentences.en: The Spirit of God moved upon the waters
sentences.pt: O Espírito de Deus se movia sobre as águas

sentences.en: God said, Let there be light
sentences.pt: Deus disse: Haja luz

sentences.en: And there was light
sentences.pt: E houve luz

sentences.en: God saw that the light was good
sentences.pt: Deus viu que a luz era boa
alt: God saw the light that it was good

sentences.en: God divided the light from the darkness
sentences.pt: Deus separou a luz das trevas

sentences.en: The light is good
sentences.pt: A luz é boa

verse.text: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.
verse.pt: No princípio, criou Deus os céus e a terra.

reading.text: In the beginning, God created the heaven and the earth. The earth was dark. Then God said: Let there be light.
reading.pt: No princípio, Deus criou o céu e a terra. A terra estava escura. Então Deus disse: Haja luz.

quiz.q: What moved upon the face of the waters?
quiz.explain: O Espírito de Deus se movia sobre a face das águas (Gênesis 1:2).

sentences.en: God called the light Day
sentences.pt: Deus chamou a luz de Dia

sentences.en: The darkness he called Night
sentences.pt: Às trevas ele chamou Noite

sentences.en: The evening and the morning were the first day
sentences.pt: A tarde e a manhã foram o primeiro dia

sentences.en: God made two great lights
sentences.pt: Deus fez dois grandes luminares

sentences.en: The sun rules the day and the moon rules the night
sentences.pt: O sol governa o dia e a lua governa a noite

sentences.en: He made the stars also
sentences.pt: Ele fez também as estrelas

sentences.en: God made the fish and the birds
sentences.pt: Deus fez os peixes e as aves

sentences.en: The animals were made on the sixth day
sentences.pt: Os animais foram feitos no sexto dia

sentences.en: In six days God made heaven and earth
sentences.pt: Em seis dias Deus fez o céu e a terra

sentences.en: On the seventh day God rested
sentences.pt: No sétimo dia Deus descansou

sentences.en: God blessed the seventh day
sentences.pt: Deus abençoou o sétimo dia

verse.text: And he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had made.
verse.pt: E descansou no sétimo dia de toda a sua obra que tinha feito.

reading.text: God made the sun, the moon and the stars. He made the fish, the birds and the animals. In six days God made everything. On the seventh day he rested.
reading.pt: Deus fez o sol, a lua e as estrelas. Ele fez os peixes, as aves e os animais. Em seis dias Deus fez tudo. No sétimo dia ele descansou.
reading.q: What did God do on the seventh day?

dialogue.line: What did God make on the fourth day?
dialogue.pt: O que Deus fez no quarto dia?
options: The sun, the moon and the stars.
dialogue.answer: The sun, the moon and the stars.
dialogue.answerPt: O sol, a lua e as estrelas.

quiz.q: How many days did God work?
quiz.explain: Em seis dias Deus fez o céu e a terra e descansou no sétimo (Gênesis 2:2; Êxodo 20:11).

sentences.en: Let us make man in our image
sentences.pt: Façamos o homem à nossa imagem

sentences.en: God created man in his own image
sentences.pt: Deus criou o homem à sua imagem

sentences.en: He created them man and woman
sentences.pt: Ele os criou homem e mulher

sentences.en: God planted a garden in Eden
sentences.pt: Deus plantou um jardim no Éden

sentences.en: The tree of life
sentences.pt: A árvore da vida

sentences.en: You may eat of every tree of the garden
sentences.pt: Podes comer de toda árvore do jardim

sentences.en: It is not good that the man should be alone
sentences.pt: Não é bom que o homem esteja só

sentences.en: God made a woman and brought her to the man
sentences.pt: Deus fez uma mulher e a trouxe ao homem

sentences.en: Eve took the fruit and ate
sentences.pt: Eva tomou o fruto e comeu

sentences.en: The man and the woman hid from God
sentences.pt: O homem e a mulher se esconderam de Deus

verse.text: And God said, Let us make man in our image, after our likeness.
verse.pt: E disse Deus: Façamos o homem à nossa imagem, conforme a nossa semelhança.

reading.text: God made man from the dust of the ground. He put the man in the garden of Eden. Then God made a woman from the rib of the man.
reading.pt: Deus fez o homem do pó da terra. Ele pôs o homem no jardim do Éden. Depois Deus fez uma mulher da costela do homem.
reading.q: What did God make from the rib of the man?

options: The tree of life is beautiful.
dialogue.answer: The tree of life is beautiful.
dialogue.answerPt: A árvore da vida é linda.

quiz.q: In whose image did God create man?
options: In the image of a king
In the image of an angel
quiz.explain: Deus criou o homem à sua imagem (Gênesis 1:27).
